review_candidates.title: [OTB Korea] Business Finance Manager
review_candidates.description: Calzaturificio Stephen is a historic Italian manufacturer of luxury men’s and women’s footwear. Founded in 1967, the Vicenza-based shoe factory has its roots in the tradition of Italian artisan production and is committed to respecting its rules and traditions, while also devoting itself to innovation. Every shoe is crafted with extreme precision, combining tradition and innovation, and embodying the true essence of Made in Italy. The entire production process occurs within the company, leading to the creation of luxury products of the highest quality. Professionalism, competence, and exceptional service have always been Calzaturificio Stephen essential values, qualities that allowed the manufacturer to establish important partnerships with famous maisons across the world. Calzaturificio Stephen is a long-standing supplier of OTB, crafting creations for some of its brands, such as Maison Margiela, and has become part of the Group through its Staff International subsidiary. Company Name : OTB Korea Limited. Job Title: Business Finance Manager Report to: Finance Director Main Duties And Responsibilities Position Summary The Business Finance Manager will play a key role in strengthening OTB Korea's finance business partnering capability across multiple brands, including Diesel, Maison Margiela, Marni, and Jil Sander. This role is designed to act as a strategic and hands-on finance partner to commercial teams, supporting brand-level performance management, profitability analysis, commercial KPI review, OPEX management, cash flow controlling, and business decision-making. As OTB Korea operates as a single legal entity managing multiple brands, the role will be important in connecting the consolidated financial view of the company with brand and store-level commercial performance. The successful candidate will help build a more structured and business-oriented Finance function, working closely with the Finance Director, Corporate Finance team, Brand leaders, Retail, Merchandising, Wholesale, and other key stakeholders. This is an exciting opportunity for a finance professional who wants to grow beyond traditional reporting and controlling, and develop into a stronger commercial finance business partner within a dynamic multi-brand luxury retail environment. Key Responsibilities Commercial Performance Support & Decision Making Monitor and analyze Brand P&L and Store P&L performance across OTB Korea brands. Provide financial insights on sales, margin, profitability, store productivity, and business performance to the Finance Director and senior stakeholders. Prepare regular commercial performance reports and management decks to support key business decisions. Identify risks, opportunities, and key drivers behind financial results. Translate financial data into clear, practical insights for non-finance stakeholders. Support regular business reviews, management discussions, and performance follow-up. Conduct ad-hoc business analysis related to sales performance, investment decisions, profitability, and business initiatives. Financial Planning & Forecasting (NOP / Budget / Forecast) Support and coordinate NOP, budget, forecast, and planning processes from a business finance perspective. Prepare and consolidate net sales planning inputs across brands and channels. Collect, review, and integrate key planning assumptions from commercial teams, including: Specific account-level plans and targets Channel-specific estimates Retail OPEX assumptions and expenditure plans Ensure consistency between business plans, financial targets, and management expectations. Prepare supporting analysis, scenarios, and explanations for planning discussions with Finance Director and Sr. Financial Controlling Manager OPEX Management Monitor and analyze commercial OPEX by brand, function, and key cost category. Support budget control and spending discipline through regular review and variance analysis. Challenge business assumptions where appropriate and provide recommendations for efficiency and cost optimization. Partner with stakeholders to ensure spending is aligned with business priorities and financial targets. Wholesale Performance & Receivables Controlling Collaborate with the Wholesale team to monitor and review GOB (Global Order Book) and delivery progress on a regular basis. Track wholesale sell-in performance against targets and flag material deviations to Finance Director. Review accounts receivable collection status to ensure payments are proceeding in accordance with contractual terms and agreed timelines. Manage and monitor cash flow implications from wholesale activities to minimize discrepancies between planned and actual cash receipts. Escalate collection risks or cash flow concerns proactively to the Finance Director and relevant commercial stakeholders. Inventory Order & Cash Flow Controlling Review and monitor inventory purchase orders to ensure alignment with approved OTB (Open to Buy) plans. Track inventory order progress and coordinate with relevant business teams to ensure delivery timelines and financial commitments are on plan. Identify and escalate deviations between planned and actual cash flow related to inventory commitments. Work closely with business teams to manage CF (Cash Flow) impact of inventory decisions, ensuring minimal variances from plan. Provide regular reporting and analysis on inventory order status and cash flow alignment to Finance Director. review_candidates.title: Verantwoordelijke interne software
review_candidates.description: Wat zal je job inhouden? Ben jij een gedreven professional met passie voor softwareontwikkeling en interne systemen? Wij zoeken nog een kenner die het voortouw neemt in optimalisatie en doorontwikkeling van interne software-oplossingen bij onze klant! Softwarematig is er geïnvesteerd in een MES-systeem en allerhande productie- en adminstratiesoftware. Daarnaast beheert een ERP-systeem alle basisdata en een PDM-pakket alle 3D-ontwerpen en 2D-tekeningen. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden: De inrichting van de software optimaliseren zodat deze aansluit bij onze bedrijfsvoering (analyseren van problemen, uitschrijven van oplossingen, uitwerken van programma's). Dankzij help-files, mondelinge ondersteuning en het delen van tips en tricks verbeter je het gebruik van onze software. Data uit systemen halen en overzichtelijk weergeven. Connecties beschrijven en aanmaken tussen verschillende pakketten/machines. Wat zoeken we? Onze ideale kandidaat is een combinatie van een analist, een ontwikkelaar en een support engineer. Je houdt steeds het resultaat als doel voor ogen. Je beschikt over de nodige technische skills en hebt kennis/ervaring van bedrijfsprocessen. Ervaring in applicatiesoftware is een pluspunt. Analytisch ben je sterk en je kan processen overzichtelijk en duidelijk beschrijven. Je werkt graag met mensen en communiceert vlot met verschillende gebruikersniveaus. Wat bieden we? Een uitdagende functie met verantwoordelijkheid en autonomie. Ruimte voor initiatief en innovatieve ideeën. Opleidings- en doorgroeimogelijkheden. Een aangename werkomgeving binnen een stabiele organisatie. Een aantrekkelijk loonpakket aangevuld met extralegale voordelen op maat van je kennis en ervaring. Klaar om mee te bouwen aan de digitale toekomst van onze organisatie? Solliciteer vandaag! Wie je ook bent, bij ons krijgt ieder talent de kans om te groeien. Diversiteit en inclusie zijn vanzelfsprekend en samen creëren we impact. #togetherwegrow

review_candidates.title: Venditore tecnico commerciale
review_candidates.description: Descrizione dell'azienda BM24 Consulting è una realtà di consulenza che supporta imprese di diversi settori nella crescita commerciale e nello sviluppo di soluzioni tecniche orientate al cliente. L’azienda promuove un ambiente di lavoro collaborativo, dove innovazione e attenzione alla qualità del servizio sono centrali. BM24 Consulting valorizza l’autonomia professionale, offrendo strumenti e supporto per sviluppare competenze tecniche e commerciali. L’organizzazione è aperta a persone motivate, orientate ai risultati e interessate a costruire relazioni di lungo periodo con i clienti. Descrizione del ruolo Venditore tecnico commerciale sarà responsabile della gestione e dello sviluppo del portafoglio clienti, con sede di lavoro a remoto, in un contesto full time. Nel quotidiano la persona condurrà attività di analisi dei bisogni dei clienti, presentazione di soluzioni tecniche e offerte commerciali, negoziazione delle condizioni e follow-up delle opportunità. Il ruolo prevede la collaborazione con i team tecnici per proporre soluzioni adeguate, la preparazione di preventivi e la gestione delle trattative fino alla chiusura dell’ordine. Sarà inoltre richiesta la partecipazione a incontri online di aggiornamento, la reportistica sulle attività commerciali e il mantenimento di relazioni continuative e professionali con i clienti. Qualifiche Il/La candidato/a deve possedere solide analytical skills, capacità di problem solving e attitudine all’analisi dei dati commerciali e tecnici. Sono richieste ottime competenze di communication, capacità di ascolto attivo e gestione professionale delle relazioni con i clienti. È importante avere esperienza in technical support e familiarità con prodotti o soluzioni tecniche, per comprendere e tradurre le esigenze dei clienti in proposte efficaci. Competenze in sales e nella conduzione di trattative commerciali sono essenziali, con orientamento al risultato e alla fidelizzazione della clientela. Esperienza in training verso clienti o colleghi è considerata un plus, insieme a capacità di organizzazione del lavoro, utilizzo di strumenti digitali e disponibilità a un costante aggiornamento professionale.
